title: Ubuntu releases before 22.04 LTS are past standard support
summary: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, the newest release this range covers, stopped receiving standard security updates on 2025-05-31; interim releases in the range ended earlier. Extended Security Maintenance is a separate paid subscription.
replacement: An Ubuntu release in standard support, such as 24.04 LTS

constraints: Upgrade one release at a time, or rebuild the host on the target LTS and redeploy the workload.
Extended Security Maintenance is a separate paid subscription; do not count it as standard support.

steps.title: Upgrade the Ubuntu host
steps.instructions: Move the host to a supported Ubuntu LTS, confirm pinned packages and services, then drain and return it to service.

verification.purpose: Confirm the host reports the target Ubuntu release.
Check that package upgrades resolve on the target release.
